pages.text: You have managed to attract some small dragon-like creatures from cold biomes using porkchops and the scent of their own kind. They excel at fighting in packs and can fire ice spikes from their bodies at creatures.

You can breed your Froststalker population using porkchops. However, be aware that their bodies cannot withstand high temperatures unless their owner wears a Frost Set. Frost Robe or Wild Robe also grant them additional passive healing.
